info.title: Link Center API
info.description: Create dynamic, editable QR codes and short links, pull scan analytics, and render branded QR images — programmatically. The QR encodes a stable short URL, so you can change the destination anytime without reprinting the code.

get.description: Return every link on the authenticated account.

post.description: Create a dynamic QR / short link. Only destinationUrl is required; name defaults to the destination's hostname. slug, logoUrl, and style are optional branding. Each create costs 1 credit (reads are free).

slug.description: Pro: custom short code (a–z, 0–9, hyphens; 3–48 chars).

logoUrl.description: Pro: center logo (https URL or base64 image data URL ≤64KB). Omit the field to inherit the account's default branding logo (if set); pass null for no logo.

style.description: Pro QR branding. Omit for the default black-on-white style.

dotColor.description: Hex color for the data dots, e.g. #0a0a0a.

cornerColor.description: Hex color for the three markers (finder patterns).

cornerSquareType.description: Marker (finder pattern) shape — applied to the frame and centre.

transparentBackground.description: When true, the QR has no background fill (overrides backgroundColor).

brandingTemplateId.description: Pro: apply a saved branding template (from GET /api/v1/branding-templates); its style/logo fill fields not set inline. Omit to inherit the account default branding.

expiresIn.description: Expiry as a duration from now, e.g. "30d", "12h", "1y". Wins over expiresAt.

expiredBehavior.description: What happens after expiry (default show_expired_page). For QR links prefer redirect_fallback.

password.description: Pro: password-protect the link. Hashed server-side; never returned.

rules.description: Pro: routing rules (ordered, first match wins).

402.description: Out of credits — each create costs 1 credit. Buy more at /settings/billing.

409.description: The requested custom slug is already taken.

patch.description: Update any of name, destinationUrl (retarget the QR), tags, active, logoUrl, or style. The slug is immutable. Pass logoUrl/style as null to clear them.

oneOf.description: Pro QR branding. Omit for the default black-on-white style.

cornerColor.description: Hex color for the three markers (finder patterns).

cornerSquareType.description: Marker (finder pattern) shape — applied to the frame and centre.

transparentBackground.description: When true, the QR has no background fill (overrides backgroundColor).

brandingTemplateId.description: Apply a saved branding template (its style/logo fill gaps; existing values win), or null to detach.

note.description: Private internal note; null clears it.

expiresAt.description: Set expiry (ISO 8601, UTC) or null to clear it. Or use expiresIn.

expiresIn.description: Set expiry as a duration from now, e.g. "30d".

password.description: Pro: set a password, or null to remove protection. Never returned.

ogMode.description: Pro: custom social preview mode; none clears it.

ogTitle.description: Pro: custom preview title; null clears.

ogDescription.description: Pro: custom preview description; null clears.

ogImageUrl.description: Pro: custom preview image (https URL); null clears.

rules.description: Pro: replace the link's routing rules (authoritative array); [] clears.

delete.description: Permanently delete the link and its short URL. The QR stops resolving.

get.description: Daily scan series plus country and device breakdowns for the last 30 days.

LinkRule.description: A routing rule. Evaluated in array order; the first rule whose conditions all match (and whose time window is open) serves its destination.

id.description: Stable id; omit on create (minted server-side), keep to preserve analytics history.

destination.description: Where this rule sends the visitor.

conditions.description: AND-combined; an empty array matches any request (catch-all).

window.description: Optional schedule (epoch ms, UTC): eligible while afterDate <= now < beforeDate.

weight.description: A/B weighted-random share (1–100). Give two or more catch-all rules a weight each to split traffic, drawn per request proportional to the weights (need not sum to 100).

BrandingTemplate.description: A reusable Pro QR branding preset (logo + colors + shapes).
